Can I reverse an array by sorting it?
Sorting takes O(N log N) time, which is slower than necessary. Have you considered using two pointers to swap elements in-place in O(N) time?

My linked list reverse function returns None for a list of size 1. Why?
Check your loop condition. If your loop only executes when there is a next node, you might be ignoring the single head node. What is your loop boundary?

Can you explain the concept of Arrays in simple terms without equations?
Think of Arrays as a row of lockers next to each other, each with a number slot. Instead of formulas, visualize how elements interact. Why do you think keeping things structured this way helps us?
